notes: Summary: Peregrine is evaluating Redwood Dedicated to host low-latency chat and reranking for maritime ops. Primary drivers: deterministic latency, tenant isolation (regulatory customers), and predictable unit economics.
Key asks: throughput guarantees + latency SLOs, clear reserved GPU sizing, mechanisms for per-route QoS, and controls to eliminate noisy-neighbor impact from background batch workloads.

Traffic shaping / priority lanes: customer needs 3 classes — control (high-priority real-time chat), standard (interactive search/rerank), bulk (offline batch reranks). Wants hard per-route concurrency caps, token rate quotas, and strict preemption rules so control-lane always wins during contention.

Isolation requirements: VPC-private control plane, logical tenant isolation on serving runtime (no shared KV cache unless explicit opt-in), per-tenant affinity slots (GPU slot reservation), and network egress tagging for EU-residency accounts.

Noisy-neighbor mitigation ideas proposed by SE: fair-share scheduling + token-bucket qps throttles, cgroup-like GPU slice enforcement for low-priority lanes, headroom reservation of 20% compute for control lane, and automatic fallback to smaller hosted model when dedicated capacity saturated.

POC plan: 2-week functional test (latency/throughput), 72-hour noisy-neighbor isolation stress test (concurrent batch jobs at 3x expected burst), and SLA language trial. Will instrument with Redwood Console tracing and per-route token accounting.

Bench numbers & assumptions: internal sim (synthetic traffic) -> 8xA100 yields ~140rps for 256 tokens (P95 230ms). Expect variance with model selection: llama-2-70b increases GPU usage 2.5x versus mistral-large. SE recommended quantized variants for batch lane.

SLA negotiation points: define clear credit calculation for sustained P95 breaches, include throughput guarantees (baseline rps with buffer), explicit definitions for scheduled maintenance, and 24/7 priority escalation path.
Customer quotes: 'We need the control lane to feel like dedicated hardware for our bridge crews — any tail spikes risk real-world impact.' — Head of Platform.

Next steps (detail): SE to kick off isolation stress harness (by 2026-03-12); Redwood legal to circulate SLA draft (by 2026-03-18); finance to confirm POC budget cap; finalize GPU sizing after 72h run.
